svg.title: Benchmark scores by task
svg.desc: Single-agent and best multi-agent mean scores across six benchmarks. Multi-agent scores are higher on Finance Agent, WorkBench, BrowseComp-Plus, and Terminal-Bench; single-agent scores are higher on PlanCraft and SWE-bench Verified. Mean scores across tested models. The best multi-agent architecture is selected separately for each benchmark. Matched system token ceilings; actual spending can differ. No pooled score or significance claim.
svg.metadata: https://www.nature.com/articles/s42256-026-01268-y | Results: domain-dependent performance; July 2026 version of record
